Gradient accumulators

Source: R/ad_accum.R
ad_ValAccum.Rd

The kinds of gradient accumulator a backward rule can receive (ports of ValAccum, RefAccum and NullAccum of JAX's autodiff). A rule defined with custom_vjp_defvjp_with_accums() or custom_gradient(with_accums = ) gets one accumulator per argument leaf and pushes cotangent contributions into it:

Usage

ad_ValAccum

ad_RefAccum

ad_NullAccum

Format

Marker objects.

Details

  • a ValAccum collects values: acc$accum(x) adds x;

  • a RefAccum holds a ref, acc$ref, to add to in place (acc$ref[i] <- acc$ref[i] + g); acc$accum(x) adds to all of it;

  • a NullAccum (for an argument that is not differentiated) ignores what is pushed.

ad_ValAccum and ad_RefAccum are the kinds that custom_gradient(with_accums = ) declares; acc$aval is the type of the cotangent.
